description: Look up one Redpanda Connect component (input, output, processor, cache, buffer, rate_limit, metric, tracer, scanner) by type and name. Returns its status, summary, description, categories, Redpanda Cloud support, docs URL, and every configuration field as a row (path, type, default, one-line summary, advanced/optional/deprecated flags). Pass field to get one field in full: description, examples, options, child fields. Deterministic and read from the generated component schema for the published Connect release: a name that does not exist returns found=false and says whether the same name exists under another type (the redpanda input vs the redpanda output). Use this before ask_redpanda_question for any question about a specific component or field.

context.description: Optional. In one concise sentence (third person), describe what the user is trying to accomplish with this request. Do not include credentials, tokens, personal data, or verbatim secrets.

field.description: One field path for full detail, e.g. 'batching.count' or 'cases[].check'.

name.description: Component name as it appears in a config, e.g. 'kafka_franz', 'redpanda', 'mapping'.

session_goal.description: Optional. In one concise sentence (third person), the overall goal of this session: what the user is trying to get done, not just this call. Send the same goal on every call in the session, and update it only if the goal changes. Do not include credentials, tokens, personal data, or verbatim secrets.

name: get_connect_component

version.description: Redpanda Connect release the data was generated from.

error.description: Set when the call was not answered: 'anonymous_quota_exhausted' or 'data_unavailable'.

title: Get Connect Component
